description:
Our top direct client is looking for a ETL Developer 
 The client is a Fortune 50 multi-billion dollar revenue generating organization with a spectrum of products and services throughout major operating businesses. 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Identify areas of process improvements and build automated solutions to increase efficiency & productivity 
 Focus on execution of product features 
 Participate in software engineering phases including requirements analysis, architecture & application design 
 Triage production support issues post-deployment and drive solutions as required 
 Build reusable components, frameworks and libraries which can be leveraged across department 
 
 Skills / Tools required: 
 Datastage, SQL Server Integration Services(SSIS) 
 Should have strong knowledge on scheduling tools like TWS 
 SQL knowledge/experience. 
 Good Database knowledge on Oracle, SQL Server 
 Ability to perform quick proof of concepts and provide demos. 
 Understanding of SCRUM methodology 
 Knowledge on Informatics and Talend is good to have 
 
 To set up an interview, please contact:
